name.description: Snake_case tool name matching the folder name under tools/

description.description: One-sentence description of what the tool does

destructive.description: True if the tool writes, deletes, or modifies external state

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input parameters

command.description: Shell command to run, with {param} placeholders matching schema properties

requires.description: Runtimes or binaries the tool depends on (e.g. python3, node, zbarimg)

env_required.description: Environment variables that must be set before the tool can run (e.g. HF_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY)
